title: Jev-optin approach re-validation v2 vs HEAD 9314599

tldr.content: The Jev-optin approach is still architecturally valid against HEAD 9314599, but the earlier re-validation under-specified two things and must be corrected. (1) requestDigest now has TWO assignment sites (index.mjs:872 primary and :1225 retry), not one; and intake does no runtime schema validation, so request/2 = new schema+registry entry PLUS marker/field extension. (2) The never-Jev boundary must grow from five items to a full enumerated enforcement surface (registry immutability, csm-verification-status/1, build completion.commit/rollback, artifact lifecycleStatus+descriptorDigest, digest anti-fabrication, the security/isolation gate set, classifyResume/retryDecision, review terminal immutability), with Jev output pinned to decision-gate-class (observational). Also: pack decision-points.json via an explicit bootstrap mapping, add the .agents/decisions/ index class, respect the <500 SKILL cap (build 476 / deep-research 472 by gate count), and follow the enforcement docs' additive dual-revision rollout order.

executiveSummary.content:
Independent re-validation of the agreed jev-optin approach (csm-approach/1, runId run-20260919t094754z-9a55d6438ca7) against the skills the approach will change, at HEAD 9314599. Source mode hybrid (repository + one vendor doc). Four parallel research tracks (orchestrate runtime anchors; schemas/registry/pack/index; in-loop enforcement surfaces; SKILL budgets + add-only review), then an independent challenge and judge.

Pipeline: INTAKE -> TRIAGE(DEEP x hybrid) -> RESEARCH(4 tracks) -> SYNTHESIZE -> CHALLENGE -> JUDGE -> REMEDIATE -> VERIFY -> SAVED.

Headline: architecture stands; integration detail changed. Two defect-class corrections (second requestDigest site; intake has no validator) and one large scope correction (never-Jev boundary). Independent challenge downgraded 4 claims and the judge returned PASS with min dimension 0.75 (clarity).

keyFindings.content: K1 supported: architecture still valid; every gate deterministic (claim-arch-valid). K2 supported: requestDigest at :872 AND :1225 (claim-requestdigest-two-sites). K3 supported: intake does no schema validation; request/2 needs schema+registry AND marker/field changes (claim-intake-no-validator). K4 supported: capabilities/2 hard-coded; revision-aware loader required (claim-capabilities-hardcoded). K5 supported: pack decision-points.json via explicit mapping (claim-pack-decision-points). K6 supported: add .agents/decisions/ index class + `## decisions/` heading (claim-decisions-index-class). K7 supported: never-Jev boundary must expand to the full enforcement surface; Jev = decision-gate class (claim-never-jev-expanded). K8 supported: SKILL cap <500; build 476 / deep-research 472 by gate count (claim-skill-line-cap). K9 partially-supported: compatibility matrix rows required but negotiation is dormant in production (claim-compat-dormant). K10 supported: seven enforcement record ids are unregistered and must be code-constructed only (claim-unregistered-receipts).

detailSections.content:
A. Orchestrate anchors. requestDigest: index.mjs:872 and :1225; materialDigest strips only status/requestDigest. intake.mjs:6 ENTRY_ENVELOPE, :9 PLAN_MARKERS, :38 case label (not a field check), :85-90 field checks; no validator import. capabilities.mjs:29-35 hard-codes schema path + revision; loadCapabilities :89-93. activation.mode readers: request-router.mjs:37, phase-compiler.mjs:185,205.

B. Registry/pack/index. Registry fields id/revision/schemaPath/aliases/immutable/unknownFieldPolicy/schemaContentDigest; $id must equal entry id; digest over canonicalized schema. Compatibility pair {schema,producerRevision,consumerRevision,status:compatible,adapter:null}; no request row; createCompatibilityRuntime test/bootstrap-only; artifact-resolver:434 guarded by compatibility truthiness. pack-bootstrap:135-153 copies index.mjs/capabilities.json/lib/schemas/output (+ SKILL.md via generic skills mapping); root decision-points.json needs an explicit entry. agents-index:20-31 needs decisions:'decisions/'; check-suite:1598-1641 enforces correct-section bullet and rejects mis-homed bullets.

C. Enforcement surface (never-Jev). Live-authoritative: registry immutable/reject (schema-runtime:202-203); csm-verification-status/1; build completion.commit/rollback (state.v2:48,59); artifact lifecycleStatus/descriptorDigest; digest anti-fabrication (loop-guard:145, loop-evaluator:191, plan.mjs:520-525); isolationGate/verifyIsolationEvidence; verifyWorkerAttestation/assertNetworkEgressContract; evaluateEgress/verifyEgressChain; aggregateGates; reviewAcceptance; autonomyGate; assertDynamicModeAllowed; validateCapabilities; classifyResume/retryDecision; review terminal immutability. Definition-only (must not be fabricated but not on the live path): validateGateReceipt (no callers), verifyAttestation (test-only). csm-orchestrate-decision-gate/1 is the observational, no-authority class.

D. Corpus/off-surface. validate-corpus-v2 revision-aware and corpus-limited to plans/build-state; .agents/decisions out of scope. 6beb11c off-surface; be130fd enforcement-adjacent.

recommendation.content: Proceed with the approach after applying the corrected adaptations, and build it in a wt/jev-optin worktree. Concretely: (A1) anchor the byte-identity differential to BOTH requestDigest sites (:872 and :1225); (A2) add request/2 schema+registry entry AND extend intake markers/field checks; (A3) make capabilities.mjs:29-35/:89-93 revision-aware while preserving activation.mode reads; (A4) register request/2 and capabilities/3 with exact field names and canonical digests; (A5) add compatibility rows for request 1->2 and capabilities 2->3 (status compatible, adapter null) noting negotiation is currently dormant; (A6) pack decision-points.json via an explicit bootstrap mapping (or relocate under lib/); (A7) add the .agents/decisions index class + `## decisions/` heading; (A8) expand the never-Jev boundary to the full enumerated surface and pin Jev output to decision-gate class; (A9) never emit the seven unregistered enforcement ids; (A10) keep decision sections within the <500 cap (build 476, deep-research 472); (A11) follow the enforcement docs' additive dual-revision rollout order with serialized payload/capabilities regeneration; (A12) no extra corpus work for .agents/decisions. Confidence high; the answer would change only if a live compatibility runtime or a new enforcement surface is introduced before the build.

unverifiedClaims.content: U1 unverifiable: the OpenRouter typed-error taxonomy (402/401/403/429/5xx/529/404) is carried from the prior finding and was NOT re-retrieved in this repository-only run; verify against https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/errors before relying on exact names. U2 partially-supported: the compatibility matrix is required by policy but has no production consumer, so its addition is correctness-preserving rather than behavior-changing today; confirm no bootstrap/consumer path activates negotiation before depending on it.

claims.statement: The Jev-optin approach remains architecturally valid against HEAD 9314599: no acceptance, security, or completion gate is delegated; the adapter is injected like the executor and all gates stay deterministic.

citations.quote: HEAD inspected read-only across the change surface

claims.statement: requestDigest is assigned in csm-orchestrate/lib/index.mjs at BOTH :872 (primary request) and :1225 (retry request), so the byte-identity differential must cover both sites; materialDigest strips only {status, requestDigest}.

csm-orchestrate/lib/intake.mjs performs NO runtime JSON-schema validation of the request envelope; request/2 opt-in therefore requires BOTH a new registered schema+registry entry AND extending the marker const (:6) and light field checks (:85-90), mirroring PLAN_MARKERS (:9).

csm-orchestrate/lib/capabilities.mjs hard-codes the revision string "csm-orchestrate-capabilities/2" and the schema path capabilities.v2.schema.json at :29-35, with loader loadCapabilities at :89-93; a capabilities/3 decision block needs a revision-aware loader here.

.skills[].activation.mode is consumed for routing only at request-router.mjs:37 and phase-compiler.mjs:185 and :205, never inside capabilities.mjs, so a revision-aware loader must preserve those reads.

Registry entries use id/revision/schemaPath/aliases/immutable/unknownFieldPolicy/schemaContentDigest; schemaContentDigest equals digest() over the canonicalized schema and the schema $id must equal the entry id.

Additive same-kind compatibility entries require {schema, producerRevision, consumerRevision, status:"compatible", adapter:null}; there is no csm-orchestrate-request row, and production never supplies a compatibility runtime (createCompatibilityRuntime is test/bootstrap-only), so artifact-resolver's negotiate() call at :434 is dormant.

scripts/pack-bootstrap.mjs copies only csm-orchestrate/{index.mjs, capabilities.json, lib/**, schemas/**, output/**} (plus SKILL.md via the generic skills mapping); a root csm-orchestrate/decision-points.json is NOT packed and needs an explicit mapping entry or relocation under lib/.
